tasks.label: Image
tasks.blurb: Upload a picture, then paste one code. Retouch through Scenes is the Persian guide. The chips after that are the older English set.

tasks.label: Design
tasks.blurb: Ads, shelves, packaging, brand marks, and layouts. Paste the code with the product or name you actually have.

tasks.label: Explain
tasks.blurb: Cutaways, mechanisms, labels, lessons, and repairs. Ask for labels only where the code calls for them.

tasks.label: Video
tasks.blurb: One code, one motion. These are the video shortcuts from public 2026 lists. A still photo is the usual input.

tasks.label: Code
tasks.blurb: Paste the code under the meaning. DEBUG, EXPLAINCODE, and OPTIMIZE are widely circulated. The rest use the same shorthand pattern.

tasks.label: Write
tasks.blurb: Tone, length, and format. Paste your text under the code so the model keeps your meaning.

tasks.label: Think
tasks.blurb: Study, decisions, critique, and idea batches. Add the audience and the decision, or the code stays vague.
